title: Payload map on an encoded pair
statement: For any function $g$ from finite bit strings to finite bit strings and any finite bit strings $a$ and $b$, applying the threaded payload map of $g$ to the encoding $\langle a,b\rangle$ gives $\langle a,g(b)\rangle$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a function from finite bit strings to finite bit strings
replaced: Let $g$ be a function from bit strings to bit strings, let $\langle a,b\rangle$ denote the self-delimiting pair encoding of bit strings $a,b$ (every bit of $a$ doubled, then $01$, then $b$), and let $\sigma_g$ be the threaded payload map of $g$, which decodes a bit string $z$ as a pair $\langle a,b\rangle$ and outputs $\langle a, g(b)\rangle$, or outputs the empty word if $z$ is not a pair encoding. Then $\sigma_g(\langle a,b\rangle) = \langle a, g(b)\rangle$ for all bit strings $a$ and $b$.
